1. 1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan

(Pindaan) (No. 2) 2019.

 (2) Perintah ini bermula berkuat kuasa pada 23 September 2019.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989], yang disebut

"Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda dalam Jadual dengan menggantikan

butiran 19 dengan butiran yang berikut:

"19. Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pesisiran Pantai Barat

(Taiping-Banting) yang bermula dari—

(a) kilometer 146.27 di Persimpangan Bertingkat Hutan Melintang

di koordinat U 423983.673, T 334021.534 Grid Bentuk Benar

Serong di Tepi (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir

di kilometer 158.40 di Persimpangan Bertingkat Teluk Intan

di koordinat U 435796.871, T 333514.926 Grid RSO Geosentrik

(GDM 2000) arah utara dan arah selatan; dan

(b) kilometer 198.24 di Persimpangan Bertingkat Kg. Lekir

di koordinat U 459179.232, T 307962.705 Grid Bentuk Benar

Serong di Tepi (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir

di kilometer 241.63 di Persimpangan Bertingkat Beruas

di koordinat U 498349.253, T 311975.628 Grid RSO Geosentrik

(GDM 2000) arah utara dan arah selatan.".

Peta

3. Jalan yang dinyatakan dalam butiran 19 Jadual kepada Perintah ibu ditunjukkan

dalam peta dalam Jadual yang berikut:

ROAD TRANSPORT 1987

NATIONAL SPEED LIMIT (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(1) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Cition and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the National Speed Limit (Amendment)

(No. 2) 2019.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 23 September 2019.

Amendment of Schedule

2. The National Speed Limit Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989], which is referred to as the

"principal Order" in this Order, is amended in the Schedule by substituting for

item 19 the following item:

"19. The part of the road known as the West Coast Expressway

(Taiping-Banting) commencing from—

(a) kilometre 146.27 at Hutan Melintang Interchange at coordinates

N 423983.673, E 334021.534 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic

(RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 158.40 at

Teluk Intan Interchange at coordinates N 435796.871, E 333514.926

of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid north bound and south

bound; and

(b) kilometre 198.24 at Kg. Lekir Interchange at coordinates

N 459179.232, E 307962.705 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic

(RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 241.63 at

Beruas Interchange at coordinates N 498349.253, E 311975.628 of

the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid north bound and south bound.".
